Olfactory_Predator_Brain.description: The Olfactory Predator Brain, a feline-morphed canine entity with heightened olfactory senses and primal instincts, stalks its prey through the shadows, guided by an unwavering will and razor-sharp claws. Its keen nose is its most powerful weapon, capable of detecting scents from miles away, making it a relentless hunter in any domain.
